baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional "if you do not find anyone in them" directly governs "do not enter them until permission is given to you."
baseline_models.mechanism: Finding is an achieved encounter, while "anyone" under negation exhausts possible persons; failure to achieve that encounter suspends entry rather than supplying positive evidence that entry is free. Only authorization releases the suspended crossing.

activation_trace.role: Finding contributes an achieved encounter and makes its negation a failure of contact, not proof of vacancy.
The negative-polarity anyone exhausts the class of possible persons and defines the no-contact condition.
Passage into an inside is the concrete act held behind the condition.
Permission is explicit authorization and functions as the sole release for the withheld entry.

changed_reading.before: If nobody appears, entering to look may be harmless.
changed_reading.after: Not encountering anyone is itself a stop condition; inference cannot substitute for permission.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive utterance "if it is said to you, return" is answered by the repeated imperative "then return."
baseline_models.mechanism: An articulated boundary is coupled to a bodily return, while the return branch also carries the image of a reply coming back. The visitor's enacted withdrawal therefore completes the speech exchange without negotiation.

activation_trace.role: An uttered statement supplies the audible boundary that initiates the exchange.
The return of an answer or speech lets the repeated return function as the visitor's enacted reply.
Actual movement back converts the verbal reply into immediate spatial compliance.
Purity and soundness positively value the completed command-response rather than treating it as social defeat.

changed_reading.before: A refusal is information that may invite explanation or negotiation.
changed_reading.after: The proper answer to the spoken boundary is the same root embodied: return, with no counterclaim required.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Returning is called "purer for you" and is immediately placed under God's knowledge of what you do.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return can be a turning away from a matter, purity can include both soundness and increase, and deliberate action remains action even when it consists in not crossing. Retreat is therefore productive moral work, not a null event.

activation_trace.role: Turning back from a matter gives the retreat a renunciatory as well as spatial force.
Growth and increase make restraint capable of producing a positive gain.
Purity and soundness identify the kind of gain produced by withdrawal.
Deliberate action counts the chosen retreat among deeds rather than absences.
Divine disclosure of the act makes even unseen compliance morally legible.

changed_reading.before: No entry means that nothing happened.
changed_reading.after: Voluntary retreat is a purifying deed that grows the visitor precisely by leaving the threshold uncrossed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Entry into "them" is prohibited until permission, even when no person is found inside.
baseline_models.mechanism: The entry root holds both physical ingress and access to an inward or secret domain. Authorization therefore protects not only floor space but whatever an unannounced crossing would disclose of the resident's concealed interior life.

activation_trace.role: Literal ingress supplies the physical threshold.
The inward and secret branch layers a protected private domain onto the spatial inside.
Authorization leaves control of disclosure with the party entitled to permit entry.
Knowledge at the close contrasts divine disclosure with the visitor's limited access to another's interior.

changed_reading.before: The rule prevents only physical trespass into a building.
changed_reading.after: The physical threshold also guards private inwardness that an unannounced entrant could force into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered sequence distinguishes another household, attempted recognition, failed contact, and a separately named class of non-inhabited useful houses. That explicit exception prevents the visitor from converting "I found nobody" into "this place is uninhabited and open."

activation_trace.role: Failed encounter remains the focus condition whose epistemic force is being sharpened.
Nobody marks absence of encountered persons without classifying the house itself.
House as household ties the protected space to its people, including people not presently visible.
Recognition by sight, sound, or perception supplies an attempted contact procedure before crossing.
The community of belonging identifies residents as the social party addressed at the threshold.
Inhabiting a dwelling supplies the explicit occupancy category negated in the following exception.
A useful provision defines the purpose-specific benefit that accompanies the non-inhabited exception.

structural_cues: The ordered 24:27-29 sequence moves from other people's houses, through failed contact, to an explicit exception for non-inhabited useful houses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three-step sequence and distinct household, occupancy, and use vocabulary; I infer that the explicit 24:29 exception blocks treating failed contact in 24:28 as proof of vacancy. Alternatively, 24:29 may be an independent exception without defining the epistemic force of 24:28.

changed_reading.before: Nobody found and nobody housed are interchangeable practical descriptions.
changed_reading.after: A visitor's failed encounter does not reclassify a household as an uninhabited useful space; only the latter receives the stated exception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Soon after the threshold rule, the same "purer for them" evaluation is attached to lowering sight and guarding bodily openings. Returning at a refused threshold can therefore be read as the spatial form of gaze restraint: the body is moved back before sight gains an unauthorized field.

activation_trace.role: Physical return supplies the bodily withdrawal that can halt visual access.
The focus's purity formula provides the lexical hinge to the later gaze rule.
Holding down and diminishing something supplies an active reduction of the gaze.
Literal eyesight identifies the sensory channel that withdrawal prevents from entering first.
Guarding sanctity and chastity gives the stopped gaze a protective function for both parties.
The bodily private opening identifies the vulnerable domain protected by visual restraint.
The repeated purity branch explicitly assigns the same evaluative result to lowered sight and guarding.

structural_cues: The threshold unit is followed two ayat later by the same azka formula, now attached to lowering gaze and guarding private parts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated purity formula and the nearby gaze/body sequence; I infer that retreat at the door is a spatial implementation of visual restraint. A live alternative is that azka is only a shared moral evaluation and does not intentionally couple the two practices.

changed_reading.before: Returning protects a resident's control of property and social availability.
changed_reading.after: Returning also stops the visitor's gaze and body at the threshold, making spatial retreat an enacted form of visual and sexual restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later household rules vary permission by time, exposure, circulation, and maturity: frequent insiders still ask at vulnerable times, while mature children adopt the fuller practice. Permission in the focus thus manages resident vulnerability dynamically rather than marking a fixed outsider/owner status.

activation_trace.role: The protected inward domain is the focus anchor whose vulnerability later rules specify.
Authorization is the shared gate through which the later role- and time-sensitive rules revise the baseline.
Permission required from habitual insiders shows that access is conditional even within a household.
Maturity supplies a changing social capacity that alters the permission protocol.
A concealed vulnerability identifies why particular times require renewed authorization.
Circulation around others explains ordinary access while making the specified privacy windows exceptional.
Repeated asking after maturity makes authorization a learned and durable boundary practice.

structural_cues: 24:58 names three exposure windows amid frequent household circulation, and 24:59 changes the asking rule when children reach maturity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared permission root plus explicit differences of time, exposure, circulation, and maturity; I infer that 24:28's threshold serves resident-controlled vulnerability rather than a static property category. Alternatively, 24:58-59 may remain a special rule for dependents with limited force for outside visitors.

changed_reading.before: Permission is a one-size-fits-all barrier between owners and outsiders.
changed_reading.after: Permission is a responsive exposure-control practice whose strictness follows vulnerability, time, and the entrant's social capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier rumor unit rejects speech and circulation unsupported by knowledge, whereas the focus requires immediate retreat on a resident's direct boundary utterance. The contrast creates an epistemic asymmetry: claims about another need evidence, but another's refusal does not need to disclose its reasons to become operative.

activation_trace.role: Failed encounter leaves the visitor with limited information rather than a basis for claims about the interior.
The direct spoken instruction is the boundary-bearing utterance whose force is contrasted with rumor.
Immediate return makes the direct boundary effective without an evidentiary hearing at the door.
Doubt and surmise supply the unstable cognition that must not harden into a claim about another.
Uttered speech becomes culpable when it carries what the speakers do not know.
Lack of disclosed knowledge marks the evidentiary defect in invasive public speech.
Spread and diffusion show the social harm produced when unsupported access to another's private reality circulates.

structural_cues: The 24:11-20 rumor sequence disciplines claims about others without knowledge; 24:28 later makes a direct resident instruction sufficient for retreat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contrast between unsupported public speech and a direct boundary command; I infer that privacy assigns them unequal burdens of proof. Alternatively, the accusation unit and doorway command may regulate separate domains with no intended epistemic comparison.

changed_reading.before: The visitor may demand a reason before accepting a refusal, just as other statements require support.
changed_reading.after: The visitor must not turn limited knowledge into either entry or inquiry: a resident's direct boundary is sufficient even when its private reason remains undisclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, permission regulates leaving a collective matter, and covert slipping away under cover is exposed. Read back into the focus, authorized movement is bidirectional: one does not press inward without leave or evade outward without leave, and an explicit return keeps movement socially legible.

activation_trace.role: Authorization at entry anchors the proposed whole-surah pattern of accountable movement.
Open return supplies a visible reversal rather than evasive persistence at the threshold.
Repeated authorization for departure reverses the spatial direction while retaining the same consent mechanism.
A person's matter or circumstance supplies the stated reason for requesting release rather than disappearing unannounced.
Secret slipping provides the concealed movement against which explicit asking and returning stand.
Hiding behind another supplies the social cover that makes unauthorized movement illegible.

structural_cues: 24:62 reverses the threshold direction by requiring permission to leave a collective matter, and 24:63 immediately contrasts that practice with covert withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated permission root, the entry/exit reversal, and the covert-exit contrast; I infer a surah-wide discipline of socially legible movement. The live alternative is that household access and collective attendance are analogous only lexically and should remain separate legal settings.

changed_reading.before: 24:28 is only a rule for crossing inward through a domestic doorway.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the doorway rule trains accountable movement itself: ask before crossing another's boundary, and reverse course openly rather than maneuvering under cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a domestic retreat through the surah's closing return to God; it remains anchored because 24:64 repeats the exact return, action, and knowledge cluster found in 24:28. Downstream prose should render it only as an exploratory whole-surah echo, never as the primary legal sense of the command.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins repeated return with God's knowledge of what people do.

activation_trace.role: The visitor's concrete return supplies the local action that receives the remote echo.
Deliberate deeds place the local retreat within an accountability frame.
Divine knowledge closes the focus by disclosing the moral weight of the visitor's action.
Final return repeats the movement root at the surah's close on an eschatological scale.
The deeds about which people are informed repeat the focus's action register.
Repeated divine knowledge closes the surah with the same disclosure frame as the focus.

changed_reading.before: Returning is exhausted by stepping away from a refused doorway.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the small voluntary return rehearses accountable return: an unseen act of restraint will not remain morally undisclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links resident permission at a doorway with divine authorization for houses to be raised and voiced; it remains valid as an analogy through the exact permission and house roots plus the focus's inside branch. Downstream prose should qualify it as an architectural resonance, not identify household consent with divine authorization.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Entry into an inside waits for authorization, so the interior is not treated as inert available space.

activation_trace.role: The inward and secret domain anchors the claim that an interior has a protected life beyond mere floor space.
Authorization makes access depend on a will other than the entrant's.
House as shelter supplies the architectural interior whose purpose is being amplified.
Divine authorization repeats the permission mechanism in a distinct, explicitly higher register.
Raising the house contributes a constructive vocation rather than merely restricting access.
Voiced remembrance gives the authorized interior an activity and sound of its own.

changed_reading.before: The house is a passive container whose doorway is temporarily closed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, waiting outside preserves an interior's authorized vocation: the entrant does not commandeer a space whose inward life is not theirs to open.

strongest_changes: Failed contact is sharply distinguished from the explicit category of an uninhabited useful house.
The repeated azka formula turns retreat at the threshold into spatial discipline of gaze and body.
Later household rules reveal permission as sensitive to exposure, circulation, maturity, and time.
The contrast with rumor makes another's direct boundary operative without forcing disclosure of its reasons.
The closing permission sequence tentatively generalizes the focus into accountable, socially legible movement.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed a simple no-entry rule into an epistemic and bodily practice: do not infer vacancy, force visibility, demand private reasons, or move covertly; returning is itself positive purifying work.
remaining_uncertainties: 24:29 may be an independent exception rather than an explicit commentary on what non-finding means in 24:28.
The repeated azka in 24:28 and 24:30 may mark parallel virtues without intentionally linking doorway retreat to gaze restraint.
The collective-exit, authorized-house, and final-return activations are traceable but should remain secondary resonances rather than merged into the domestic rule.
